states.buttons: Primary hover is espresso; light hover is pale olive. Focus is clay on paper and paper on olive. No active, disabled or loading styles exist.
states.navigation: aria-current=page shows the desktop underline. aria-expanded updates the short mobile dropdown and toggle-line rotation. Escape closes and restores focus.
states.categories: aria-current=location shows the paper underline. Selecting a category clears search. The active category scrolls into the mobile rail; reduced-motion uses instant scrolling.
states.search: Non-empty input reveals the clear control; Escape or reset restores input focus. Results use a polite live region. Empty results reveal the existing primary reset action. Controls are progressively enhanced.
states.map: Native details open state rotates the summary plus by 45deg. Hover is pale olive; focus is paper.
states.openingStatus: Written open/closed text accompanies the dot; Berlin-time status is progressively enhanced.

notCanonized: The existing search-clear × text glyph is not included as a reusable icon pattern; the shipped documenter forbids canonizing glyph icons. It was not repaired within this documentation-only boundary.
The existing CAFE lockup is part of the preserved identity asset, not a section-eyebrow vocabulary.
Temporary stock photography is an implementation limitation; it is not proof of actual venue, staff or customers.

narrative.overview:
Café Window Lettering gives Lagano a sturdy, welcoming voice: clear signage, a familiar serif name, warm paper and deep olive surfaces. The atmosphere is that of a contemporary European neighbourhood café, with Balkan sociability expressed through conversation and the real drinks rather than decorative cultural motifs.

The system is open and editorial. Strong type, unequal rectangular photographs and deliberate space carry the identity; useful rules organize information. It should feel relaxed and human, with enough visual confidence to avoid a generic café template. The pinned brand brief rejects luxury restaurant styling, SaaS presentation, decorative cards and pills, gradients and excessive shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Sturdy Archivo signage with a preserved Instrument Serif wordmark.
Deep olive fields and warm paper, with clay reserved for interaction accents.
Open typographic rows, clear reading rails and aligned prices.
Sharp photographs at varied scales, with natural café light.
Short, calm state transitions and complete reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Field and Signal Rule
rules.body: Olive and paper establish the atmosphere; clay marks hover and focus. Preserve the light text and light focus treatment when a control sits on olive.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo for information and sturdy signage; reserve Instrument Serif for the name and selected conversational emphasis. Do not repeat a serif-and-italic heading formula throughout a page.

rules.name: The Open Reading Rule
rules.body: Separate content with whitespace and useful rules. Keep names and prices in aligned rows, with flexible names and unbroken prices, instead of placing each drink inside a container.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: A component is flat at rest and during interaction. Use color, underlining and visible focus to communicate state; do not add elevation to simulate affordance.

dos: **Do** use the frontmatter's exact olive, paper and text colors with their established light/dark roles.
**Do** keep Archivo as the information voice and preserve the lowercase Instrument Serif wordmark.
**Do** build clear reading rails and aligned rows with flexible names, unbroken prices and useful rules.
**Do** vary photograph scale within sharp containers and keep images replaceable through reserved dimensions and adjustable crops.
**Do** use visible keyboard focus, written status, semantic state attributes and the complete reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** keep menu facts and destinations tied to the project's existing verified sources.
donts: **Don't** introduce cards around every item, nested cards, pill controls, giant radii, gradients, glass effects or decorative shadows.
**Don't** turn every section into the same serif-and-italic split composition or add repeated eyebrow labels.
**Don't** use cultural motifs, luxury cues or decorative icons as a substitute for the café's warm, sociable character.
**Don't** hide the menu or navigation behind JavaScript, or let sticky controls cover anchor targets.
**Don't** add reveal choreography, parallax or looping decorative motion to the restrained interaction vocabulary.
**Don't** present temporary café photographs as actual Lagano premises, staff or customers, or invent prices and business details.
